uutiset.t: SEC Moves to Directly Oversee Database Criticized by Wall Street
uutiset.s: The Securities and Exchange Commission moved Friday to bring a controversial trade reporting database loathed by much of Wall Street under its direct oversight.

uutiset.t: Anthropic’s IPO Drew More Retail Investor Demand Than SpaceX
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering drew roughly between $115 billion and $120 billion of demand for shares from retail investors, according to a person familiar with the matter, more than the amount sought by them in SpaceX’s debut.

uutiset.t: Wall Street Regulator Probing Nvidia’s Accounting, Reuters Says
uutiset.s: The US Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating the accounting practices of Nvidia Corp., Reuters reported Friday, as the challenges facing the chipmaker continue to mount in the wake of Jensen Huang’s departure as chief executive officer.

uutiset.t: Apollo Enlists 13 Wall Street Banks for $9 Billion ADT Debt Deal
uutiset.s: Apollo Global Management Inc. has brought in 13 Wall Street lenders for a roughly $9 billion debt package it underwrote for Thrive Holdings Inc.’s acquisition of home security provider ADT Inc., according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Asset-Backed Debt Sales Top Post-GFC Record on AI Strength
uutiset.s: Sales of asset-backed securities have surpassed their highest level since the Great Financial Crisis for a third straight year, as builders of artificial intelligence infrastructure continue to tap markets for financing and cash-rich insurance firms hunt for high-yielding debt.

uutiset.t: Canada Stocks Eye Longest Losing Streak Since 2023 on Tech Rout
uutiset.s: Canada’s major equities index is on track to fall for seven straight sessions in a broad selloff sparked by technology and commodities stocks on Friday, marking the benchmark’s longest losing streak in three years.

uutiset.t: Omers Private Capital Chief Exits to Lead Pension-Owned Teranet
uutiset.s: Ontario Municipal Employees Retirement System’s head of private capital, Michael Block, is leaving the pension manager to be chief executive officer of Teranet Inc., one of its infrastructure portfolio companies.

uutiset.s: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook sees an urgent need for the US central bank to raise interest rates to bring down inflation. uutiset.t: Argentina Hit Hard by Global Turmoil as Bonds Slip Into Distress
uutiset.s: A global flight from risk is catching Argentina at a vulnerable moment, deepening a bond selloff fueled by anxiety over next year’s election and pushing its debt into distressed territory for the first time in two years.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Share Slide Almost Erases IPO Pop as AI Trade Unravels
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares erased much of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors’ faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.
